look_here_first: Think tall riparian Amorpha: false indigo bush is a much larger open shrub with long pinnate leaves, many broad oval leaflets, and elongated purple flower spikes carried at the ends of upper branches.

lookalikes.differences: A. fruticosa is the tall riparian member of the local comparison set. A. canescens is much shorter, gray-hairy and prairie-like; A. roemeriana is a smaller limestone shrub with greener less-hairy foliage.
